<objective>
Make the top bar stop looking like unfinished chrome, using only the visual language already in
this codebase.

The bar reads as plain for three concrete reasons, not for taste:

1. **No current-page marker.** `top-bar.tsx` draws Sheds, Loans and Log the same way on every
   page, while the tab strip one file away already marks its current tab with an accent underline.
2. **No focus ring in the bar.** The logo link and all three page links are bare anchors, while
   every button and tab elsewhere carries a visible ring.
3. **Hover is only a colour swap on a 20px target** inside a 48px bar, and the logo fades on hover
   when it should gain presence.

Purpose: continue the established brand feel (square corners, small upper-case labels, the accent
reserved for emphasis) instead of inventing new bar styling.
Output: one changed file, `src/web/shell/top-bar.tsx`.

**Scope fence.** Page structure, routes, link set, the status dot, the mode switch and the toast
tray are out of scope. No new files, no new packages, no edits to `globals.css`.
</objective>

<constraints>
Read these before the first edit. Each is a decision already made in this codebase.

- **The theme is locked.** Every colour must resolve through an existing token: `--background`,
  `--foreground`, `--muted`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border`, `--accent`, `--ring`. No hex values,
  no new custom properties, no edits to `globals.css`.
- **The bar is full width on purpose.** The bar and the toast tray both use `px-5 sm:px-6` with no
  maximum width, framing page columns that are centred. Do not add a centring wrapper.
- **Corners are square.** `button.tsx` and `dialog.tsx` both use no rounding. Do not add pills.
- **The accent has a known contrast.** It measures 2.9:1 on the dark background, noted in three
  files and accepted to match the theme, so the accent may colour the underline and the logo hover
  but the current label must stay `text-foreground`. Current state is shown three ways: label
  contrast, the underline and `aria-current`.
- **No new packages and no new test tooling.** The runner has no browser DOM, so no component test
  can read rendered classes. Automated checks here are build, lint and source greps; the visual
  claim is settled by the blocking checkpoint in Task 3.
</constraints>

  <action>
    Five scoped edits inside the file Task 1 restructured. Every class already appears elsewhere in
    this codebase.

    **(a) The bar element.** Stretch its children to fill the 48px height, name the bottom border
    explicitly, and pin it to the top with a z-index between the table header and the dialog layer.

    **(b) The logo link.** Reverse the hover so it moves toward the accent, add the ring recipe from
    the button, and raise the wordmark one size so it carries its share of the bar.

    **(c) A divider between logo and links.** Place a vertical divider, hidden below 640px, and
    tighten the surrounding gap so the divider creates the separation instead of adding to it.

    **(d) The link group.** Stretch it to the full bar height so each link fills it.

    **(e) The three links.** One shared class string plus a two-way conditional on the Task 1 flag:
    a relative parent for the underline, horizontal padding, the existing small upper-case label,
    the ghost hover surface and the ring recipe. Current gets full-foreground text and a visible
    underline; others stay muted and brighten on hover. Never colour the current label with the accent.

    Update the file header and inline comments so they describe the bar as it now is, without
    deleting any existing decision comment.
